title: Generated artifacts manifest
description: docs/generated/artifacts.{json,yaml}: the index of every file majordomus generate writes — the documents with the encodings each is committed in, and every file with its encoding, contract, source, size and hash. docs/generated/artifacts.md is the same index for a reader.

schema.description: The schema id its structured encodings carry.

path.description: Repository-relative, or absolute for an allow-list when the tool distribution lives outside the repository it is supervising.

describes_itself.description: This manifest's own encodings, which carry no hash: a document that hashed itself would have no fixed point. `majordomus generate --check` compares them byte for byte instead.

allOf.description: Every artifact but the manifest's own carries its size and hash.
The manifest's own encodings carry neither.

format.description: The encoding, which also fixes the form of the provenance header: members for json, a comment banner for yaml and text, an HTML comment for markdown.
